findings.detail: Rows following preferred-equity positions repeat only numeric totals/percentages and are continuation or rollup rows, not additional investments.

rationale: B02 is a CIK-quarter duplicate-position-key flag. The filing's own total investment fair value is 2,783,476 thousand, matching the bundle's 2783.476 million internal anchor, so the aggregate anchor is not bad. In the preferred-equity SOI section, source position rows such as Ranger Parent I, Inc. at table 51 row 6 are immediately followed by numeric-only rows such as row 7, and the MC CIF rows 9-10 are followed by numeric-only row 11. Those numeric-only rows are subtotal/continuation presentation rows, not separate instruments. Treating them as positions would create duplicate or non-position keys, so the B02 flag is a real extraction/row-disposition defect.
